### Fixed

- *(aggregator)* Core_auth_logout on a subject-scoped issuer revokes the person's grant even when other MCPServers share the issuer — clears every session's tokens for it, disconnects every server of the issuer in the person's sessions, names the siblings in the result in [#1149](https://github.com/giantswarm/muster/pull/1149) by [@teemow](https://github.com/teemow)
